extracted_concepts.name: Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Whole and non-whole quantities used in arithmetic.

extracted_concepts.name: Integers
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Whole numbers including negatives and zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimals
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Base-ten notation for fractional values.

extracted_concepts.name: Fractions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Ratios expressed as numerator over denominator.

extracted_concepts.name: Percentage
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A ratio expressed per hundred.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Comparison of two quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebra
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of symbols and rules for manipulating expressions.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic expressions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Combinations of numbers and variables using operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Equations of degree one.

extracted_concepts.name: Simultaneous linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Multiple linear equations solved together.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Degree-two equations solved by factorizing or formula.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequalities
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Statements comparing expressions with inequality symbols.

extracted_concepts.name: Functions
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mappings from inputs to outputs.

extracted_concepts.name: Coordinate geometry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Geometry using coordinates and equations.

extracted_concepts.name: Cartesian coordinate system
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Plane defined by x and y axes.

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rate of change of y with x for a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation of a straight line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Linear relation y = mx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Distance
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Length between two points.

extracted_concepts.name: Mensuration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measurement of length, area, volume, and related quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two-dimensional measure of a region.

extracted_concepts.name: Volume
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Three-dimensional measure of space.

extracted_concepts.name: Geometry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of shapes, sizes, and spatial properties.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle theorems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Results about angles and chords in circles.

extracted_concepts.name: Similarity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures with same shape but possibly different size.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures with identical shape and size.

extracted_concepts.name: Enlargement
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Transformation scaling a figure by a scale factor.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometry
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Study of angles, sides, and trigonometric ratios.

extracted_concepts.name: SOH CAH TOA
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Mnemonic for sine, cosine, tangent in right triangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Vectors
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Quantities with magnitude and direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Transformations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Operations moving or resizing shapes in a plane.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of likelihood of events.

extracted_concepts.name: Sample space
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Set of all possible outcomes.

extracted_concepts.name: Mutually exclusive events
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Events that cannot occur together.

extracted_concepts.name: Independent events
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Events whose occurrence does not affect each other.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given another event occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Collection, organization, and interpretation of data.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Average value of a data set.

extracted_concepts.name: Histograms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Bar charts showing frequency distributions.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rectangular arrays of numbers.

extracted_concepts.name: Inverse matrices
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Matrices that reverse another matrix's effect.
